lcc_original: 瑪勒列生雅列之後，又活了八百三十年，這期間還生兒養女。
notes: 並且 (UNV) → 這期間還 (LCC): 這期間還 is an interpretive expansion with no direct Hebrew equivalents and receives no SN tags; 生 still carries H03205/WTH8686 as the main verb.
{<WAH0853>} kept implicit — LCC has no explicit word for the Hebrew direct object marker (את), same situation as UNV.
Two H08141 occurrences preserved: first attached to 百 reflecting the Hebrew construct שְׁמֹנֶה מֵאֹות שָׁנָה (eight hundred [years]), second to 年 for the explicit final 年.
